svg.desc: ScadaCraft OpenBridge widget: Number input (obc-number-input-field, OpenBridge 1.0.0, Apache-2.0). Library: OpenBridge · Controls. Box 192x48 px, anchor at (0,0). Bindable properties: _pn_value (default 0, rw): Value, written on Enter or when the field loses focus _pn_decimals (default 1, read): Decimals shown _ps_unit (default '', read): Engineering unit _pb_disabled (default false, read): Disabled (operator cannot act)
